title: I made a dark fantasy strategy game. The free demo is out and I'd love honest feedback
author: Tumeshka-gamedev

comments.author: Tumeshka-gamedev
comments.body:
The emperor is dead, the empire hasn't noticed, and you rule one province on its rim. Every lord around you wants the empty throne. It's turn-based: you pick a deed, pick a lord on the map, see your odds and throw a d20. You also send adventurers into ruins, lay siege to towns and play the assault yourself on a hex board.

The demo is the first act, six years in game, on Windows, Linux and Mac. It's free.

I'm putting it out to hear from as many players as I can while the game is still being made. What bored you, what broke, what made no sense. Blunt is fine.



[https://tumeshka.itch.io/kill-the-empire](https://tumeshka.itch.io/kill-the-empire)

comments.author: Tumeshka-gamedev
comments.body:
How it's made:

\- Art: generated, then cut up and rebuilt as a paper-collage look so the cast and backdrops match

\- Voices: generated (ElevenLabs), a few hundred voiced lines in the demo

\- Music and sounds: generated

\- Code: written with AI help, Electron for the desktop build
